title: LeanCTX Authority Decision v1
description: Immutable, policy-bound, signed approval evidence. Every field that identifies what was decided, who decided it and under which policy is required; the signature lives in the referenced signature-envelope record.

scope.description: Must equal the scope of the referenced promotion, policy and context object component by component.

promotion_digest.description: Record digest of the exact promotion request version this decision answers.

decided_by.description: Approver. MUST NOT equal the referenced promotion's requested_by, MUST hold an active same-scope membership whose role grants 'promotion.decide', and MUST be the signature envelope's signed_by.

policy_digest.description: Record digest of the active same-scope promotion_authority policy applied. Must equal the referenced promotion's policy_digest.

signature_envelope_digest.description: Record digest of the signature-envelope whose signed_payload_kind is 'authority-decision' and whose signed_payload_digest is this record's digest with signature_envelope_digest omitted.
